observations: Function `collect(item, bucket=None)` accepts an item and an optional bucket argument.
When `bucket is None`, a new empty list is assigned to the local name `bucket` before appending.
The function appends `item` to `bucket` and returns `bucket` on every call.
The default value is `None`, not a mutable list, so omitted-bucket calls do not share a default object.
An explicitly supplied bucket is mutated in place via `append` and returned.
No authorization, input validation, or external state access appears in the shown lines.
